title: From Data Quality to Data Trustworthiness in AI-Driven Software-Intensive Embedded Systems: A Systematic Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.23252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-driven software-intensive embedded systems (SIES) depend on data during development and operation. Poor data quality (DQ) may weaken data trustworthiness, yet evidence about its effects and lifecycle management remains fragmented. This systematic literature review synthesizes 27 primary studies published from January 2020 to February 2026. It examines DQ concerns and evidence linking them to reduced data trustworthiness, along with assessment and management methods. The review identifies 16 concerns organized as Source Quality and Content Quality. Studies provide DQ-based scores and evidence of effects on model or decision performance. Synthesis suggests upstream source or handling problems may become embedded in training baselines and remain difficult to detect at runtime. Eight method categories were identified. Runtime monitoring is the largest category, while upstream and training-time controls remain poorly integrated with runt

translated_title: 从数据质量到AI驱动软件密集型嵌入式系统中的数据可信性：一项系统性综述
translated_abstract: AI驱动的软件密集型嵌入式系统（SIES）在开发和运行过程中高度依赖数据。糟糕的数据质量（DQ）可能削弱数据的可信性，然而关于其影响及生命周期管理的证据仍然碎片化。本系统性文献综述综合了2020年1月至2026年2月间发表的27项原始研究，考察了数据质量问题及其与数据可信性降低之间的关联证据，以及相关的评估和管理方法。该综述识别出16个数据质量关注点，并归纳为“来源质量”和“内容质量”两大类。已有研究提供了基于数据质量的评分，以及数据质量对模型或决策性能影响的证据。综合分析表明，上游的来源问题或处理问题可能会被嵌入训练基线之中，并在运行时难以检测。综述共识别出八类方法，其中运行时监控是规模最大的类别，而上游和训练时的控制措施与运行时监控的整合仍然不足。
tldr: 本系统性综述识别了AI驱动软件密集型嵌入式系统中影响数据可信性的16个数据质量关注点和8类评估管理方法，并揭示上游数据问题可能嵌入训练基线且在运行时难以检测。
en_tdlr: This systematic review identifies 16 data quality concerns and 8 assessment/management method categories affecting data trustworthiness in AI-driven software-intensive embedded systems, revealing that upstream data problems may become embedded in training baselines and remain difficult to detect at runtime.
